stem: Vertex News found sustained low utilization on a c7g fleet and wants lower cost while preserving peak-hour performance. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Replace all instances with Spot capacity only
Step down one size where metrics show sustained headroom
Switch to Compute Savings Plans while keeping current oversized instance sizes
Keep Auto Scaling so peak-hour scale-out still occurs after rightsizing
Downsize all nodes and lower Auto Scaling maximum to the new baseline

rationale: Rightsizing down where long-term headroom exists directly reduces baseline spend. Keeping Auto Scaling preserves the ability to scale back out during peak periods after rightsizing. Spot-only replacement for all capacity can add interruption risk for noninterruptible baseline traffic. Applying Savings Plans to an oversized fleet improves price rate but keeps utilization waste from oversizing. Lowering Auto Scaling maximum to the new baseline can block required peak-hour scale-out.
